sentences.text: No pre-payment charges are applicable for a cash credit or overdraft facility if the borrower intimates the bank of an intention not to renew the facility before the period in the loan agreement, and the facility is closed on the due date. (type=fact)

The same directions also say that, for cash credit or overdraft facilities, pre-payment charges on closure before the due date are otherwise levied on an amount not exceeding the sanctioned limit. (type=fact)

These pre-payment-charge directions apply to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, and the applicable status for this facility cannot be confirmed from the materials provided because the sanction or renewal date is not given. (type=fact)

missing.searched: Checked the UCB pre-payment-charge directions for applicability to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026; the case facts only identify a cash credit overdraft facility.
